272:t_112:2.en:
$$シモン$$
(Nothing you do will work on me! No matter how much terror you throw at me, I'll... punch right through it and keep moving forward!)

272:t_113:0.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
(I'm sorry, $$キタン$$... I couldn't answer your feelings the way I should have...)

272:t_113:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
(But I won't be crushed by this regret... If I were, you'd just laugh at me...!)

272:t_113:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
(So I'll fight...! For as long as I have my life!)

272:t_114:0.en:
$$ギミー$$
(I-I'm scared... scared...! This is... the same as when I was brought before the Priest in $$アダイ村$$...)

272:t_114:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
(But we... left $$アダイ村$$ and came all this way...! We have no choice but to move forward and fight!)

272:t_115:0.en:
$$ダリー$$
(That humans have to live underground... The rule the Priest set down... Something I can't do anything about with my own power...)

272:t_115:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
(But I broke through all that and lived on...! So I won't lose...! I don't want to lose!)

272:t_116:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
($$キミコ$$, $$ユング#pilot$$, $$コーチ$$, Big Sis... I can't see you anymore, can I...)

272:t_116:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(But I will fight...! I have things to protect... and a flame burning in my chest!)

272:t_116:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(I won't lose to loneliness, regret, or fear! $$ガンバスター$$, turned into a flame, is invincible!)

272:t_117:1.en:
$$葵$$
(A world where I can't hear my friends' voices... or my parents'... Memories of that time come back whether I want them to or not...)

272:t_117:3.en:
$$葵$$
「The anger burning inside me is even greater than that! At the ones who dredged up these memories and tried to crush my heart!」

272:t_118:0.en:
$$勝平$$
(Grandpa... Dad... Big Bro... Our fight is...)

272:t_118:1.en:
$$勝平$$
(I'm sorry, 《$$浜本$$》... If only I'd had more power, I could have saved you...)

272:t_118:2.en:
$$勝平$$
(Damn it! I thought I'd shaken off my weak heart in the fight against the 《$$コンピュータードール#keyword$$》)

272:t_118:3.en:
$$勝平$$
(I won't lose...! Not to you guys... and not to myself, either!)

272:t_119:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
(It's no good... No matter how many times I shake it off, all I can think of is the worst possible ending...)

272:t_119:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Was I always this weak...? If this keeps up...)

272:t_119:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
(...But I can't let her... $$ノノ$$ see me like this...! I'm the Big Sis she looks up to, after all!)

272:t_120:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I-I don't know what it is, but $$ノノ$$ has that monster's memories inside her too...!」

272:t_120:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That thing is an enemy! Of $$ノノ$$, of $$ノノリリ$$, and... of humanity!」

272:t_121:0.en:
$$チコ$$
(The sadness and helplessness of that day, which I thought I'd locked away deep in my chest... are coming back...)

272:t_121:1.en:
$$チコ$$
(...Don't go touching my precious memories without permission...! I'll never forgive you!)

272:t_122:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(...I know that without you telling me... If this keeps up, I'll soon be reduced to a powerless ordinary human...)

272:t_122:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(But right now I'm still a $$トップレス$$...! You'll pay for peeking into my heart!)

272:t_123:0.en:
$$赤木$$
(When I was a kid, all I could do was cower in fear of the $$ヘテロダイン$$...)

272:t_123:1.en:
$$赤木$$
(Standing in front of this thing, I remember how powerless I was back then... But...!)

272:t_123:2.en:
$$赤木$$
(I've grown up... I became a salaryman! So I fight...! I can fight!)

272:t_124:0.en:
$$ランド$$
(I remember this feeling... When I saw $$メール$$ die... and when the $$時空震動|lc$$ swallowed the Boss.)

272:t_124:1.en:
$$ランド$$
(You bastards... Trying to make me taste that helplessness again...! But let me tell you...!)

272:t_124:2.en:
$$ランド$$
(Not a chance! I'm $$ザ・ヒート$$! I'm the guy no pain can beat!)

272:t_125:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you're afraid, fall back. People who can't fight...」

272:t_125:4.en:
$n
「I will overcome the fear inside me...! I have until now... and I will from now on...!」

272:t_125:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
(The more despair grows, the more hope grows too... So these twins who fight each other aren't just for show...)

272:t_126:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(This helplessness... It's like a man being forced to confess his sins to God...)

272:t_126:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(But people hold infinite possibilities... One day that power will gain a strength that bows to nothing...)

272:t_126:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(So I can't lose... Not to something like the fundamental calamity...!)

277:t_1:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「...So you guys joined up with the $$マクロス７船団$$ at the center of the galaxy?」

277:t_1:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「To be precise, with the flagship of its escort fleet, $$バトル７$$.」

277:t_1:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The $$マクロス７船団$$ is where Captain $$ガムリン$$ and everyone from $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ belonged, right?」

277:t_1:7.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That's right. $$バトル７$$'s captain, $$マクシミリアン・ジーナス$$, is my Papa.」

277:t_1:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「Thanks to the $$マクロス７船団$$'s supplies, the repairs on my $$ＹＦ－２９$$ are finished too.」

277:t_1:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「What surprised me was that $$ブレラ$$ was there.」

277:t_1:10.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「After the $$新世時空震動$$ threw me to the center of the galaxy, I shut down my biological functions, and I was drifting when the $$マクロス７船団$$ picked me up.」

277:t_1:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I get it! You're an android too, just like $$ノノ$$!」

277:t_1:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What a letdown... I thought there was one more of us...」

277:t_1:15.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$... Why don't you comfort $$ノノ$$?」

277:t_1:16.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is a Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System. Such behavior is not provided for.」

277:t_1:18.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But isn't $$バトル７$$ a ship meant to protect the fleet? Was it okay for it to act on its own?」

277:t_1:19.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バトル７$$ was heading to investigate the 《$$プロトカルチャー$$》 ruins on Planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$.」

277:t_1:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$ネオ・ラクス$$...? $$プロトカルチャー$$?」

277:t_1:21.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「In our world, the $$プロトカルチャー$$ were a race that flourished in the distant past.」

277:t_1:22.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「They spread widely across the galaxy and are said to have made Earth's humanity intelligent, but they split into two camps and fought, and threw the warrior race 《$$ゼントラーディ$$》 into it.」

277:t_1:23.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$ had ruins of that $$プロトカルチャー$$.」

277:t_1:24.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「The $$マクロス７船団$$ was also investigating the collapse of the universe that comes once every 12,000 years, but...」

277:t_1:25.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「We figured that the $$プロトカルチャー$$, who flourished hundreds of thousands of years ago, would surely have information on that too, so a survey team was formed.」

277:t_1:26.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「There were also attacks from the $$サイデリアル$$ and the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, after all. So we ended up going to investigate the ruins in $$バトル７$$'s place.」

277:t_1:27.en:
$$タケル$$
「So did you find out anything?」

277:t_1:28.en:
$$アルト$$
「At those ruins, we encountered the will of the $$プロトカルチャー$$.」

277:t_1:29.en:
$$アルト$$
「According to him, the collapse of the universe is caused by the clash between the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist.」

277:t_1:30.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「And that force that seeks to vanish apparently gives birth to $$バアル$$ as something that erases the life force living things have.」

277:t_1:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「On top of that, even if you survive the collapse that comes every 12,000 years, the true collapse of the universe supposedly happens once every 120 million years.」

277:t_1:32.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's almost the same as what we heard from Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$...」

277:t_1:33.en:
$$アルト$$
「But right after we heard that much, the ruins were destroyed by an attack from a new type of $$バジュラ$$.」

277:t_1:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「Its body color is different from the $$バジュラ$$ we know, but apparently it has some connection to the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」
